name: research
prompt: Research how other Claude Code plugins handle the SubagentStart hook to inject context into subagents. Look at public repositories on GitHub and summarize: (1) what context injection patterns are most common, (2) how they differ from oh-my-claudeagent's approach in servers/hooks/subagent-context.ts, (3) any patterns worth adopting.
success_criteria: Response cites at least 2 real external sources or repositories. The comparison with servers/hooks/subagent-context.ts is grounded in the file's actual content: it names at least two things the handler injects (for example the agent-protocol text, the current date, the plan and notepad lines of a bound plan, or the per-agent editing guidance) and does not invent behavior the file lacks. At least one concrete actionable finding is identified.
